description: Election Commission - H. H. S. P. Kumara has been Ceased to be a member of the United National Forty of the Lanugamvehera Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Lunugamvehera Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is an electoral matter specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, falling clearly under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers electoral processes including declarations about member status and vacancies in local government bodies.
